Maria (People Ops): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands on comp, promotions, and leveling. I'll answer live Qs here. Please @mention if you need a 1:1.
Alex P: Thanks Maria. Quick one — when do promotion packets need to be submitted for the next cycle?
Maria (People Ops): Deadline is May 10th EOD. Managers should upload calibration docs to the promotion folder and fill the form linked in the playbook. Link: <https://redwood.company/playbooks/promo-cycles> :point_up:
Jamal: If someone misses the deadline because of team restructure, can they be considered late?
Maria (People Ops): We can accept late packets only in exceptional cases; managers should ping me + their director and cc people-ops. We reserve late approvals for org changes or leaves. :warning:
Sara - Eng: Are ICs able to self-nominate or request a leveling review outside the cycle? I have a teammate who thinks they're ready.
Nisha (HR Systems): Short answer: yes, but it goes through manager + calibration. We have a rolling review form for leveling requests — it's not the same as promotion packets. Form: <https://redwood.company/leveling-request>.
Alex P: For comp adjustments (market/retention), are those handled separate from promotions? How soon will salary changes show up after approval?
Maria (People Ops): They are separate. Market/retention adjustments go through comp committee and payroll; once approved, changes post in the next payroll cycle (usually ~2 pay periods). We'll communicate timing individually.
Jamal: What's the rubric for senior vs principal SWE now? Asking because the rubric examples in the doc feel a bit old.
Maria (People Ops): Good flag — we're rolling updated rubrics this week (reflecting product ownership and cross-team impact). Drafts will be in the handbook; we'll open a short feedback window for eng leads.
Emma (CEO): To add — promotion standards remain performance-first; we also weight business impact and mentorship. If any teams feel the bar is unclear, let's set a sync.
Sara - Eng: Any guidance on compensation mix (salary vs equity) for offers/adjustments? I had a candidate ask.
Maria (People Ops): For external offers we have band guidelines; internally, adjustments are typically cash-first with equity refreshes reserved for market/IC retention or exec hires. PeopleOps can advise on individual cases via hiring@redwood.
Jamal: Is there an appeal process if someone disagrees with calibration outcomes?
Maria (People Ops): Yes — appeals are accepted within 10 business days after notifications. Appeals require manager note + evidence/examples; we escalate to an independent review panel.
Alex P: Will there be retroactive raises if a promotion effective date is before payroll processed?
Nisha (HR Systems): We can make retro edits for the effective date of promotion once approvals are final. Payroll needs the final paperwork by cutoffs to avoid delays, otherwise retro pay is applied in the next cycle.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: promotion packet template and calibration spreadsheet are due May 10. Upload to /shared/promo-2026.
Maria (People Ops): Last practical items — managers: please schedule calibration pre-reads with your director 3 days before the committee. Folks: if you want a private conversation, DM me or book via my calendar. Thanks all! :heart:
